title: Object-Only Is Not Context-Free: A Counterfactual Diagnostic for Context Removal in Object Retrieval
summary: The Keyhole Aperture Probe held object pixels fixed while varying surrounding context and found that retrieval descriptors from ten backbones remained context-dependent. A lightweight adapter reduced that dependence and improved or preserved retrieval accuracy on two datasets compared with a matched fine-tuning control.
ai_technology: Object-retrieval feature descriptors tested under context removal
